$comment: Documented exceptions for the `audit` CI job (scripts/audit-check.mjs).
Every entry MUST carry: an `advisory` (GHSA id) or a `package` scope, a `reason`,
an `approvedBy`, and an `expires` date (YYYY-MM-DD). An entry without `expires`,
or past its `expires` date, does not waive anything AND fails the job — an expired
waiver forces a re-review instead of letting accepted risk become permanent.
Prefer advisory-scoped entries. Package-scoped entries are used below only where a
single upstream version bump resolves a whole cluster of advisories at once, and
enumerating 30+ ids would imply a per-advisory review that did not happen.
Baseline recorded 2026-08-14 during the P0-adapted slice: npm audit reported
14 vulnerabilities (2 low, 11 high, 1 critical) against the dependency set pinned

exceptions.reason: next is pinned at exactly 14.2.0; the fix is 14.2.35 (non-semver-major, same 14.2.x line) and clears this cluster plus the postcss chain. Deliberately NOT applied in the P0-adapted slice: the working tree carried uncommitted UI work at the time, and a framework bump needs its own reviewable change with a full test/lint/build pass. This is the highest-priority follow-on slice and the expiry is set short to force it.
exceptions.remediation: Set "next": "14.2.35" in package.json, npm install, then re-run test/lint/build and delete this entry.

exceptions.reason: Reached transitively through next@14.2.0's bundled toolchain; resolved by the same next 14.2.35 bump as above. Build-time CSS processing only — not an input path exposed to untrusted request data in this repo.

Dev-only lint toolchain (eslint-config-next 14.2.0). npm reports the fix as eslint-config-next@16.3.1, a semver-major jump that would outpace the pinned Next 14 runtime. Not reachable at runtime or in the deployed bundle.
exceptions.remediation: Re-evaluate when the app moves off Next 14; align eslint-config-next with the runtime major.

exceptions.reason: Same dev-only lint toolchain cluster as @next/eslint-plugin-next; fix requires the same semver-major bump. Not reachable at runtime.
exceptions.remediation: Re-evaluate when the app moves off Next 14.

exceptions.reason: Command injection in the glob CLI's -c/--cmd flag. Reached only as a transitive dev dependency of the lint toolchain; this repo never invokes the glob CLI, and no CI job passes -c/--cmd.
exceptions.remediation: Cleared by the eslint-config-next major bump.

exceptions.reason: Dev-only TypeScript lint parser, transitive under eslint-config-next. Not reachable at runtime or in the deployed bundle.
exceptions.remediation: Cleared by the eslint-config-next major bump.

exceptions.reason: Dev-only TypeScript lint AST layer, transitive under eslint-config-next. Not reachable at runtime or in the deployed bundle.
exceptions.remediation: Cleared by the eslint-config-next major bump.

exceptions.reason: ReDoS/OOM via crafted brace patterns. Transitive under the dev lint/build toolchain; patterns are authored in this repo's own config, never taken from untrusted input.
exceptions.remediation: npm audit fix resolves this without a major bump; fold into the next dependency slice.

exceptions.reason: ReDoS via crafted glob patterns. Transitive under the dev lint/build toolchain; patterns are repo-authored, never untrusted input.
exceptions.remediation: npm audit fix resolves this without a major bump; fold into the next dependency slice.

exceptions.reason: Quadratic-CPU DoS parsing crafted YAML. Transitive under the dev toolchain; this repo parses no untrusted YAML at runtime.
exceptions.remediation: npm audit fix resolves this without a major bump; fold into the next dependency slice.

exceptions.reason: Infinite loop on negative/zero size in the non-secure generator. Transitive under the build toolchain; this repo does not call nanoid with caller-controlled size.
exceptions.remediation: npm audit fix resolves this without a major bump; fold into the next dependency slice.

exceptions.reason: Uninitialised memory disclosure / memory-exhaustion DoS. Present transitively through the dev toolchain, not through @supabase/supabase-js's browser realtime path in the deployed bundle.
exceptions.remediation: npm audit fix resolves this without a major bump; confirm the deployed bundle is unaffected, then fold into the next dependency slice.
